narrative:
Fairfield County has 111,836 registered voters, with 14.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 28.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 20.3 percentage points. Gen X are the largest generational cohort at 26.4% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -2.7% D−R vs -20.4% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
